json_schema_metadata_note: `$schema` and `$id` identify this JSON contract document for tooling; they do not make this file the executable validator for canonical work-area frames.
title: WorkAreaContentHashContract
description: W1 interface contract for the single content-addressed work-area hash shared by SCM, buck2/RBE, and CD artifact identity. This locks the hash/id boundary only; it does not implement bespoke SCM, AST parsing, RBE, or CD runtime behavior.

_meta.purpose: Name the canonical inputs and byte-identical outputs for the work-area hash so downstream SCM, buck2/RBE, and CD lanes do not invent divergent identifiers.
_meta.schema_posture: This file is a machine-readable contract document consumed by future Rust gates; it is not itself the JSON Schema validator for work-area canonical frames.

can_claim_now: The repository has a W1 machine-readable contract for the single work-area content hash required by ADR-0517 and ADR-0520.
The contract names the canonical hash inputs and requires SCM id, buck2/RBE key, and CD artifact hash outputs to be byte-identical aliases.
cannot_claim_yet: bespoke SCM storage or pipeline execution
CD artifact production or rollout readiness

hash_contract.canonical_serialization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme over UTF-8
hash_contract.hash_scope: content-only work-area identity; tenant/repository/cache namespaces wrap the alias externally and must not change the digest bytes
hash_contract.collision_policy: treat any same-hash/different-frame observation as a critical integrity event; quarantine affected SCM/CI/CD records until the source frame is audited

canonical_frame_inputs.description: Literal schema discriminator `platform/work-area-content-hash/v1`; changing the canonical frame is a new version, not an in-place mutation.

Sorted concrete work-area members from the WorkAreaTree view: repo-relative normalized paths plus optional stable AST symbol ids when available. AST identifiers are deterministic metadata slots only; absence must be encoded deterministically and W1 does not prescribe parser implementation or parser-specific shape.

Content-addressed WorkAreaTree root digest over every member. Later owned AST parsers may supply node identity behind the interface, but W1 only fixes the stable output fields and does not couple consumers to a parser runtime.
For every member: normalized path, entry kind, executable bit when applicable, raw-content sha256, and AST node/subtree digest when present. Entries are sorted by normalized path and then symbol id.

Declared in-repo dependency edges consumed by affected-target selection: package/target labels, generated-source edges, IDL/schema edges, policy/gate contract refs, and doc/ADR refs that the WorkAreaTree says are load-bearing for this work area.

Version constants for WorkAreaTree, scm-facts, buck2/RBE adapter, gate contract, and CD release-ledger adapter. Toolchain binaries, host paths, runner ids, and secrets are excluded unless later promoted as declared content inputs.

Reference to the scm-facts snapshot or future ScmFactsSource emission proving the tracked-path universe and revision provenance used to construct the WorkAreaTree. Author names, author timestamps, moving HEAD-only data, and local branch names are not hash inputs.

excluded_inputs: process ids, runner ids, workspace temp dirs, and local usernames
network availability or remote service timing
untracked files and ignored build outputs
secrets, credentials, tokens, and tenant-private environment variables
current HEAD when it advances without content-frame changes
author names, author emails, and author timestamps

scm_change_id.role: SCM ChangeUnit/change id, lease id seed, and review/attestation subject for any future SCM storage implementation

buck2_rbe_key.role: buck2 affected-target key and RBE/CAS cache identity for the work-area content frame. Action-specific salts may be stored as separate fields but must not alter this alias.

cd_artifact_hash.role: CD release-ledger artifact identity and rollout provenance subject. Physical OCI/container/blob digests attach as evidence under this hash; they do not replace it.

alias_invariants.rule: SCM, buck2/RBE, and CD records MUST carry the exact same byte string for `scm_change_id`, `buck2_rbe_key`, `cd_artifact_hash`, and `work_area_hash`.

Consumer-specific prefixes, tenant namespaces, repository namespaces, cache buckets, release-ledger partitions, and policy labels wrap the hash externally; they MUST NOT be embedded into or rewrite the digest bytes.

A consumer MAY store secondary evidence digests such as OCI image digest, action digest, SBOM digest, or provenance bundle digest, but merge/admit/promote joins use `work_area_hash` as the primary key.
Affected-target or RBE-cache hits are latency evidence only; they cannot replace the full required governance merge/admission authority described by ADR-0515 and ADR-0520.

required_governance_authority.rule: Merge/admission authority comes from the protected required governance status context and its evidence bundle; affected-target and RBE results are performance inputs only.
required_governance_authority.final_shape: owned API-driven pipeline admission service with the same fail-closed authority semantics
required_governance_authority.naming_constraint: `presubmit` is a temporary bridge context name and must not constrain final API, service, capability, or resource names.

scm.rule: The first durable identifier emitted for a work-area ChangeUnit is `scm_change_id = work_area_hash`; later bespoke-SCM storage may change implementation, never the id alias.

buck2_rbe.rule: Buck2 affected selection and RBE/CAS records index the work-area content frame with `buck2_rbe_key = work_area_hash`; action digests, toolchain cache keys, and remote-execution metadata remain secondary evidence fields.

cd.rule: CD release-ledger records and rollout provenance use `cd_artifact_hash = work_area_hash`; physical artifact digests must cite this source hash and cannot become a divergent primary id.

attestation.rule: Audit-chain, SLSA/provenance, and multispectrum evidence subjects use `work_area_hash` as the join key across SCM, CI, and CD events.

acceptance_fixtures.description: A canonical frame with stable WorkAreaTree inputs emits one `wa1:sha256:*` value and all four aliases carry that exact byte string.
Any record where SCM id, buck2/RBE key, or CD artifact hash differs from `work_area_hash` violates WAH-ALIAS-001.
A canonical frame that includes mtime, absolute path, runner id, untracked file, secret, author timestamp, or moving HEAD-only data violates the excluded-input contract.
A CI decision that treats an affected-target/RBE cache hit as merge authority without the full required governance admission context violates WAH-ALIAS-004.

downstream_dependencies: W2 WorkAreaTree parser and AST node identity implementation
local_verification_authority: The commands below are local validation aids only; merge/admission authority remains the protected governance context evidence bundle named in required_governance_authority.
